desc: Implement a Fenwick tree (BIT) that supports point updates and prefix sum queries, initialized to represent N empty slots (each slot has value 1).
Implement a function to find the smallest index `idx` such that the prefix sum up to `idx` equals a given value `k` (i.e., the k-th empty slot) using binary lifting on the BIT in O(log N).
Read the input N and the array P.
Initialize an array `A` of size N+1 to store the result.
Iterate from i = N down to 1: find the P_i-th empty slot using the BIT, place i in A at that slot, and update the BIT to mark that slot as filled (set value to 0).
Print the resulting array A from index 1 to N.
